Our 8-day, 7-night Ladakh trip with Ladakh Mountain Tour and Travels was fantastic. First, special thanks to Sahil and Javed for organizing our group of six.
We visited: Leh, the Hall of Fame, Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, Spituk Monastery, Sangam Ghat (river rafting, the world’s highest racing kart, and ATV rides), Khardung La, Hunder, Nubra Valley, the Shyok River, Panamik, Pangong Lake, Hanle, Umling La, Tso Moriri Lake, Tanglang La Pass, Puga Valley, Thiksey Monastery, Rancho School, and Sindhu Ghat.
Our hotels were comfortable, and the food and room service were well maintained at every stop.
Experience and support:
One member of our group experienced breathing/oxygen problems. Our assigned cab driver was extremely helpful—he took us to the hospital at night, assisted with communication when we faced language barriers, and even lent his phone so the patient could speak with family when Jio network coverage was poor. The people of Ladakh were consistently helpful and supportive.
Once again, thanks to Ladakh Mountain Tour and Travels for a memorable trip.
